description: A support between sessions, run by the person being coached, with the steps they agreed on. It comes at 8:30, asks at 12:30 whether the first task is started, and reaches you again at 19:00, all with cards.
name: Between sessions

steps.description: Only those. If a fourth comes to mind, write it down for the next session and leave it there.
steps.title: Read the 2 or 3 steps you agreed

steps.description: Two minutes counts as started. At midday it asks whether you have: Next means yes, Not yet asks again in a while.
steps.title: Start the first one

triggers.question: Did you start the first task?

steps.description: Say what got in the way, and leave out whose fault it was. "Nothing" is a good answer.
steps.title: One line on what got in the way

steps.description: One task, from your agreed steps, small enough to start in the first ten minutes.
steps.title: Choose tomorrow's first task

steps.description: Any other day, press Not now and then Skip. The question can be about anything you would like to bring.
steps.title: On a Friday, write one question for the next session
